Novikov Armor.description: RSI's entry-level light personal armour. Balanced ballistic and energy protection with minimal mobility penalty.
Novikov Armor.notes: Available in several colour variants. Good starter armour for FPS newcomers.

Pembroke Armor.description: RSI medium-weight duty armour providing solid protection across all damage types with moderate mobility.
Pembroke Armor.buy_locations: New Babbage (MicroTech Plaza), Orison (Crusader store), Lorville (J&J Electronics)
Pembroke Armor.notes: Reliable all-rounder for security and combat operators. Popular with bounty hunters.

Calva Armor.description: Lightweight Greycat industrial protection suit adapted for FPS combat. Good mobility and basic ballistic coverage.
Calva Armor.notes: Budget option. Low cost but limited protection. Good for non-combat scenarios.

Pyro RGD Armor.description: Battle-hardened medium-heavy armour found in the Pyro system. Superior resistance to ballistic and fire damage.
Pyro RGD Armor.buy_locations: Pyro system — Ruin Station, Bloom, various Pyro outposts
Pyro RGD Armor.notes: Optimal for Pyro operations. High-heat environments are mitigated. Hard to source in Stanton.

Devastator Armor.description: Kastak Arms' premium heavy infantry armour. Maximum protection at the cost of significant mobility reduction.
Devastator Armor.buy_locations: Lorville (Tammany and Sons), Area18 (Garrity Defense), Levski
Devastator Armor.notes: Best-in-class protection. Slower movement and higher stamina drain. Recommended for UGF assaults.

Paladin Armor.description: Purpose-built security and law-enforcement medium armour from Kastak Arms. High ballistic resistance.
Paladin Armor.buy_locations: Lorville (Tammany and Sons), Hurston security offices
Paladin Armor.notes: Good ballistic-focused medium armour. Popular with security contractors. Slightly less energy resist than Pembroke.

Aves Armor.description: RSI expedition and scout armour optimised for mobility and environmental monitoring.
Aves Armor.notes: Excellent temperature management. Preferred by explorers and deep-space operators.

Ghost Armor.description: Gemini stealth armour with IR signature reduction. Allows penetration of secured areas with minimal detection.
Ghost Armor.notes: Low protection but excellent stealth. Ideal for espionage, infiltration, and grey/illegal contracts.

Centurion Armor.description: Gemini's versatile medium combat armour offering balanced protection and good agility for security operators.
Centurion Armor.buy_locations: Grim HEX (Conscientious Objects), Levski, Port Olisar-era stocks
Centurion Armor.notes: Balanced energy and ballistic resist. Reliable option for mixed-combat scenarios.

Laminare Armor.description: Greycat lightweight composite armour with improved articulation. Designed for industrial worker protection.
Laminare Armor.notes: Industrial focus. Not optimised for direct combat. Good for mining / salvage crews that need some protection.

Inquisitor Armor.description: Agressive-profile Kastak Arms armour for high-threat enforcement and bounty hunting operations.
Inquisitor Armor.notes: Strong all-round protection. Heavier than Paladin but lighter than Devastator. Good for bounty hunters.

Marauder Armor.description: Kastak Arms' assault-heavy armour for frontline combat. Near-maximum protection at the cost of speed.
Marauder Armor.notes: Slightly lighter than Devastator but nearly equivalent protection. Preferred by assault specialists.

Orison Guardian Armor.description: Crusader Industries security armour styled for Orison platform guards. Good energy protection.
Orison Guardian Armor.notes: Higher energy resist than most medium armours. Suited for Crusader platform and atmospheric operations.

Advocate Armor.description: Standard UEE Advocacy field armour. Issued to Advocacy agents. Balanced across all resistance types.
Advocate Armor.buy_locations: Lorville (Teasa Spaceport area), Area18 (ArcCorp security office)
Advocate Armor.notes: Government-issue look. Solid medium armour. Sometimes found as mission reward or purchased in-game.

Voyager Armor.description: General-purpose Crusader Industries medium armour for explorers and multi-role operators.
Voyager Armor.notes: Excellent environmental resistance. Popular with explorers going to Pyro. Mid-tier combat protection.

Impact Armor.description: Combat-oriented medium armour with emphasis on absorbing high-impact ballistic rounds.
Impact Armor.notes: Specialised ballistic protection. Trade-off: energy and distortion resist are below average for its class.

Salvo Armor.description: Heavy infantry armour designed for sustained frontline combat. Highest-tier protection available.
Salvo Armor.notes: Maximum resistance. Very heavy — noticeably slower movement. Best for static defence or UGF assault breaching.

Invictus Armor.description: Aegis-branded medium combat armour with military aesthetics. Available during Fleet Week or via select retailers.
Invictus Armor.buy_locations: Invictus Launch Week event, some in-game armour shops
Invictus Armor.notes: Military-grade quality. Limited availability outside events. Good balanced protection.

Odyssey Exploration Suit.description: Purpose-built exploration suit with radiation shielding, enhanced oxygen reserves, and environmental monitoring.
Odyssey Exploration Suit.notes: Not combat-oriented. Prioritise environmental survival over protection. Ideal for Pyro exploration.

Nine Tails Soldier Armor.description: Worn by Nine Tails operatives throughout Stanton. Can be looted from defeated Nine Tails forces or purchased at outlaw posts.
Nine Tails Soldier Armor.buy_locations: Looted from NPCs, Grim HEX black market, outlaw outposts
Nine Tails Soldier Armor.notes: Wearing this armour may flag you as hostile to security. Check crime stat implications.
